title: I Worked Hard on It
can_do: 说出自己的感受，并补充一个与刚才事件直接相关的原因。

conversation_move.label: name a feeling and its reason

trigger: The child's block tower falls after a long build, and Mom notices the child stop.
core_response: I'm upset because my tower fell.
stretch_response: I'm upset because I worked hard on it.
repair_response: I need a short break before I rebuild.
setting: Building a block tower at home.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Your tower fell down. How are you feeling?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I'm upset because I worked hard on it.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Do you want help, or do you need a break?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I need a short break, then I want to rebuild.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: I will keep the blocks here until you are ready.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Thanks. I feel calmer sitting with you.

replay_cards.title: The torn picture
replay_cards.change: The paper tears near a finished part
replay_cards.challenge: Name sadness and the reason, choose help or a break, then decide how to repair the picture

replay_cards.title: The missed turn
replay_cards.change: The child realizes a turn was skipped
replay_cards.challenge: Name frustration and why, tell Dad, restore the missed turn, and continue

parent_support: Accept the feeling without correcting it or rushing to cheer the child up.
Offer two useful next steps and let the child choose one.
